```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.dpi = 150)
```

# 1. Configuration

```{r config}
wd_mirna <- "F:/wd/cohort7_miRNAs/cohort7_miRNAs"

input_csv <- file.path(
  wd_mirna,
  "output/02_integration/2026-04-27/union/shared_gene_correspondence_long.csv"
)
union_csv <- file.path(
  wd_mirna,
  "output/02_integration/2026-04-27/union/negative_cosine_pairs_union.csv"
)

tissue_order <- c("hypo", "liver", "panc", "gut", "ewat", "iwat", "bat", "gas", "sol")

out_dir <- dirname(input_csv)

stopifnot(file.exists(input_csv), file.exists(union_csv))
cat("Input :", input_csv, "\n")
cat("Output:", out_dir,   "\n")
```

# 2. Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
```

# 3. Load and reshape data

`miRNAs` column contains semicolon-separated miRNA names. Expand to one row
per gene × tissue × miRNA, then summarise across tissues to gene × miRNA level.

```{r load}
raw <- read.csv(input_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat("Raw rows:", nrow(raw), "  Unique genes:", n_distinct(raw$SYMBOL), "\n")

# miRNA cluster lookup from union pairs
mirna_lut <- read.csv(union_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  distinct(miRNA_Name, miRNA_cluster) %>%
  mutate(
    miRNA_short   = sub("^mmu-", "", miRNA_Name),
    miRNA_cluster = as.character(miRNA_cluster)
  )

# Expand semicolon-separated miRNAs
long <- raw %>%
  mutate(miRNA_list = strsplit(miRNAs, ";")) %>%
  unnest(miRNA_list) %>%
  mutate(
    miRNA_short = sub("^mmu-", "", trimws(miRNA_list)),
    tissue      = factor(tissue, levels = tissue_order)
  )

cat("Expanded rows:", nrow(long), "\n")
cat("Unique miRNAs:", n_distinct(long$miRNA_short), "\n")
```

# 4. Build gene × miRNA summary matrix

For each gene–miRNA pair, compute:

- `tissues_str`: tissue labels concatenated
- `cosine_med`: median of `cosine_median` across tissues

```{r matrix}
mat_df <- long %>%
  group_by(SYMBOL, miRNA_short) %>%
  summarise(
    tissues_str = paste(sort(unique(as.character(tissue))), collapse = ";"),
    cosine_med  = median(cosine_median, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups     = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(mirna_lut %>% dplyr::select(miRNA_short, miRNA_cluster),
            by = "miRNA_short")

cat("Matrix rows (gene x miRNA pairs):", nrow(mat_df), "\n")
print(mat_df, n = Inf)
```

# 5. Determine axis order

Genes ordered alphabetically. miRNAs ordered by miRNA_cluster (ascending),
then n_pairs (total pairs in union) descending within cluster — matching the S4f convention.

```{r axis-order}
# Gene order: alphabetical
gene_order <- sort(unique(mat_df$SYMBOL))

# miRNA order: cluster asc, then total pairs desc (S4f convention)
mirna_npairs <- read.csv(union_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(miRNA_short = sub("^mmu-", "", miRNA_Name)) %>%
  count(miRNA_short, miRNA_cluster, name = "n_pairs") %>%
  mutate(miRNA_cluster = factor(as.character(miRNA_cluster),
                                levels = as.character(sort(unique(as.integer(
                                  as.character(miRNA_cluster))))))) %>%
  arrange(miRNA_cluster, desc(n_pairs))

mirna_order <- mirna_npairs %>%
  filter(miRNA_short %in% mat_df$miRNA_short) %>%
  pull(miRNA_short)

cat("Gene order  :", paste(gene_order,  collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("miRNA order :", paste(mirna_order, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# 6. Binary presence/absence matrix

Filled cell = gene–miRNA pair detected; empty cell = not detected.
miRNA clusters separated by vertical lines.

```{r binary-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
# Expand to full gene × miRNA grid; absent pairs get detected = 0
plot_df <- mat_df %>%
  mutate(detected = 1L) %>%
  complete(SYMBOL = gene_order, miRNA_short = mirna_order,
           fill = list(detected = 0L)) %>%
  mutate(
    SYMBOL      = factor(SYMBOL,      levels = rev(gene_order)),
    miRNA_short = factor(miRNA_short, levels = mirna_order),
    detected    = factor(detected,    levels = c(0L, 1L))
  )

# miRNA cluster boundary positions (x-axis)
mirna_seq <- tibble(miRNA_short = mirna_order) %>%
  left_join(mirna_npairs %>% dplyr::select(miRNA_short, miRNA_cluster),
            by = "miRNA_short") %>%
  mutate(pos = row_number(), miRNA_cluster = as.character(miRNA_cluster))

mirna_bounds <- mirna_seq %>%
  group_by(miRNA_cluster) %>%
  summarise(last_pos = max(pos), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(miRNA_cluster) %>%
  slice(-n()) %>%
  pull(last_pos) + 0.5

mirna_mids <- mirna_seq %>%
  group_by(miRNA_cluster) %>%
  summarise(mid = mean(pos), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(miRNA_cluster)

n_mirna <- length(mirna_order)
n_gene  <- length(gene_order)

p_bin <- ggplot(plot_df,
                aes(x = miRNA_short, y = SYMBOL, fill = detected)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mirna_bounds, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.6) +
  # miRNA cluster labels (top)
  annotate("text",
           x = mirna_mids$mid, y = n_gene + 0.8,
           label = paste0("C", mirna_mids$miRNA_cluster),
           size = 3, fontface = "bold", color = "grey20") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "#F0F0F0", "1" = "#2C7BB6"),
                    name = "Detected",
                    labels = c("0" = "No", "1" = "Yes")) +
  coord_fixed(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "Shared target genes × miRNA — presence/absence",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.margin     = margin(5, 20, 5, 5),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 9, face = "italic"),
    panel.grid      = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p_bin)

# Dynamic ggsave dimensions
cell_in <- 0.5
fig_w   <- n_mirna * cell_in + 3.5
fig_h   <- n_gene  * cell_in + 2.5

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "shared_gene_miRNA_matrix.svg"),
       p_bin, width = fig_w, height = fig_h, limitsize = FALSE)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "shared_gene_miRNA_matrix.png"),
       p_bin, width = fig_w, height = fig_h, dpi = 300, limitsize = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("Saved: shared_gene_miRNA_matrix.svg / .png  (%.1f x %.1f in)\n",
            fig_w, fig_h))
```

# 7. Summary table

```{r summary}
mat_df %>%
  arrange(SYMBOL, miRNA_cluster, miRNA_short) %>%
  dplyr::select(SYMBOL, miRNA_cluster, miRNA_short, tissues_str, cosine_med) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

write.csv(mat_df,
          file.path(out_dir, "shared_gene_miRNA_matrix.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
cat("Saved: shared_gene_miRNA_matrix.csv\n")
```

